Apple Cinnamon Chia Pudding 
meal prep | under 300 calories | breakfast diaries | overnight recipe | sugar free

Nutrition: 
C: 45 | F: 13 | P: 8
Calories: 294 per serve
Serves 2

Ingredients
1/4 cup chia seeds
1 cup milk, plant based, regular, lactose free you choose :) 
1 tsp monkfruit or 1/4 tsp vanilla also makes it slightly sweet if you dont want to add sugar | monkfruit here
2 apples, peeled and cubed 
1 tsp cinnamon, adjust as much or as little as you like
1 tsp monkfruit, depends on how sweet the apples are, you can skip if not needed

Method
add chia + milk + monkfruit to a bowl and mix together 
leave it on the counter for 20 minutes, stir again and then refridgerate (we do this so the chia doesnt clump up which prevents max absorbtion overnight) 
to make the apple cinnamon, combine the apple + cinnamon + monkfruit in a pan and cook for a few minutes till whole but mushy or make it super mushy you do you :) you might need a little water to prevent burning. Store overnight and next morning layer everything and enjoy :)
